projects.name: Kabul Plaza Saljuqi
projects.description: Kabul Plaza Saljuqi offers modern 3, 4, and 5-bedroom luxury apartments with separate guest rooms (Mehmankhana) in the prime commercial and residential heart of Shahr-e-Naw, Kabul. Featuring 11 stories with a 1st floor commercial supermarket, 2nd to 10th typical residential floors (Units A, B, C), and 11th floor VIP penthouse terrace residences. Built with reinforced seismic-resistant concrete, dual elevators, underground car parking ramp, central heating, and 24/7 solar backup.

projects.name: Moon Residency
projects.description: Moon Residency by Kabul Plaza Developments is an architectural residential landmark on the main boulevard of Kart-e-Char, Kabul. Featuring 10 floors with a 1st floor commercial shopping galleria (525 m²) and 2nd to 10th typical residential floors with four distinct apartment typologies (Units 01, 02, 03, 04) per floor. Built with seismic-rated reinforced concrete, dual passenger elevators, underground car parking ramp, central heating, and 24/7 backup power.

projects.name: Kabul Plaza Burj
projects.description: Kabul Plaza Burj is a landmark 15-story tower at Ansari Square in Shahr-e-Naw, Kabul. It integrates a 2-level commercial shopping galleria (Kabul Mall, 63 premier retail shops), 3rd & 4th floor executive studio residences (28 studios), 5th floor private garden terrace, 6th to 14th typical luxury residential floors offering 6 expansive apartments per floor (3+1 and 4+1 layouts from 171.66 m² to 279.46 m²), and 15th-floor grand VIP penthouse suites (1212.7 m²). Engineered with reinforced seismic damping concrete, 3 high-speed elevators, multi-level underground parking, central climate control, and uninterrupted 24/7 backup power.

projects.name: Kabul Plaza 12
projects.description: Kabul Plaza 12 is a 10-story mixed-use development situated on the main boulevard of Kart-e-Char, Kabul. Featuring a 1st floor commercial shopping center (310 m²), a 2nd floor business level (316.12 m²), 3rd to 8th typical residential floors with symmetrical 3+1 luxury residences (158.06 m² each with private guest Mehmankhana), 4th & 9th floor terrace apartments (157.25 m²), and a 10th floor exclusive rooftop penthouse residence (179.96 m²). Designed with seismic-resistant frame, dual elevators, underground car park, and solar backup.

projects.name: Kabul Plaza 09 (ABC)
projects.location: Haj o Awqaf, Shahr-e-Naw, Kabul, Afghanistan
projects.description: Kabul Plaza ABC (Kabul Plaza 09) is an exclusive boutique residential tower located in the prestigious Haj o Awqaf / Shahr-e-Naw district of Kabul. Offering 9 stories including 1st floor commercial retail (170 m²), 2nd to 7th typical floors featuring two spacious 4+1 bedroom residences per floor (175.08 m² and 167.68 m²), and dramatic 8th & 9th floor two-story Duplex Penthouses (346.8 m² and 332.8 m² with private green sky-roof terraces). Built with premium imported finishes, earthquake-engineered structural frame, high-speed elevator, and 24/7 security.
